'''Rod Latham Ralltiir Lockdown''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds49.htm Ralltiir Lockdown], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228073225/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds49.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
